Description: #1 launch platform. Prepare 1 week: maker profile + teaser + community support. Hit front page for 5K-15K visitors in one day.
Tips: Book a target date early|Build hunter network 2 weeks before|Prepare all assets (video+GIF+copy) in advance|Launch Tuesday-Thursday for best results
Anti_Pattern: Launching without preparation|Launching before core loop works|Expecting sustained traffic from single launch

Description: Show HN post with genuine technical story. Front page = 5-50K visitors. Authentic engineering stories perform best.
Tips: Write genuine technical narrative|Be responsive in comments|Show the engineering trade-offs|Include live demo link
Anti_Pattern: Posting marketing fluff|Astroturfing fake upvotes|Being defensive in comments|Non-technical products

Description: Early access platform for startups in beta. Good for collecting initial waitlist signups before public launch.
Tips: Submit early — review takes 1-2 weeks|Write compelling tagline|Have landing page ready
Anti_Pattern: Submitting before landing page is ready|No clear value prop on submission

Description: Community of indie makers. Share milestones + revenue numbers. Build-in-public friendly. Good for bootstrap validation.
Tips: Share real numbers (revenue/users)|Ask for genuine feedback|Engage with other makers' posts
Anti_Pattern: Only self-promoting without engaging|Exaggerating metrics|Posting without contributing first

Description: Lifetime deal marketplace. High volume but lower revenue per user. Use for early traction and social proof, NOT for revenue model.
Tips: Prepare support capacity|Set clear scope for LTD tier|Use as validation not business model|Collect reviews aggressively
Anti_Pattern: Making LTD your primary revenue model|Not limiting LTD features vs regular pricing|Overwhelmed by support volume

Description: Business software review platform. Critical for B2B credibility. Buyers check G2 before purchasing. Must-have for B2B SaaS.
Tips: Ask happy customers to leave reviews|Respond to all reviews|Complete full profile with screenshots
Anti_Pattern: Ignoring negative reviews|Fake reviews (G2 detects them)|Incomplete profile

Description: Software review directory owned by Gartner. Strong SEO — Capterra pages rank for 'best X software' queries.
Tips: Complete profile fully|Encourage verified reviews|Add comparison data
Anti_Pattern: Same as G2 anti-patterns|Not monitoring your listing

Description: Directory of open-source alternatives to popular software. Great for OSS projects positioning as alternatives.
Tips: Position clearly what you're an alternative TO|Include self-host instructions|Highlight what's different vs incumbent
Anti_Pattern: Listing without clear differentiation|Claiming you replace something you don't

Description: Software discovery platform. Users find alternatives and compare tools. Good long-tail organic traffic.
Tips: Complete profile with pricing info|Add integrations list|Respond to user questions

Description: Largest AI tool directory (10K+ tools). Critical listing for any AI-powered product. Users actively search for AI solutions.
Tips: Write clear use-case description|Add real screenshots|Choose correct categories
Anti_Pattern: Submitting non-AI product|Vague description without specific use cases

Description: Launch on relevant subreddits with genuine post. Follow subreddit rules strictly. Best subreddits: r/SideProject r/SaaS r/indiehackers r/webdev (Showoff Saturday).
Tips: Check rules before posting|Use correct flair|Be transparent you're the maker|Respond to every comment
Anti_Pattern: Astroturfing multiple accounts|Ignoring subreddit rules|Pure promotional posts|Posting same content across many subreddits simultaneously

Description: Cross-post technical content to built-in developer audience. Near-zero effort if already writing blog. Good SEO juice.
Tips: Cross-post from blog with canonical URL|Engage with comments|Use relevant tags|Add series for multi-part content
Anti_Pattern: Only cross-posting without engaging|Spamming promotional content|Not using canonical URLs (duplicate content)

Description: Share your building journey on Twitter/X. Milestones + metrics + lessons. Compounds over time. Authentic \u003e polished.
Tips: Share real metrics weekly|Engage with other builders|Use consistent hashtags|Thread long-form stories
Anti_Pattern: Only sharing wins (no lessons)|Posting without engaging|Treating it as broadcast not conversation

Description: Founder-led LinkedIn content. Professional storytelling + product updates. 5x engagement for personal stories vs company posts.
Tips: Tell founder story not company story|Use carousel format for highest reach|Comment on prospects' posts first
Anti_Pattern: Cold pitching in DMs|Only sharing company updates|Auto-connecting without personalization

Description: Facebook groups for LTD hunters: Saas Warrior (2M+ members), LTD Hunt, Lifetimo. High volume low-price users for social proof.
Tips: Engage genuinely in groups before promoting|Offer exclusive group deals|Be transparent about roadmap
Anti_Pattern: Spamming groups with links|Not delivering on promises|Using LTD as primary revenue strategy
